$description: The EarthRanger legacy palette, as drawn in the Ecoscope Figma file (node 9810-2108). Values only: every token name is the one @allenai/design-system already publishes, so nothing in the app changes but the color. Edit a hex here and the whole app follows, CSS and map alike.

ui-cta-primary.note: The legacy dark mode in Figma (frame 9810-3037) pairs the CTA Blue/1 with Blue/3. GlobalMenuDrawer is dark chrome inside the light theme rather than a dark-mode surface, so it reads var(--er-blue-7) directly, a mid blue picked for that chrome; marking it [data-theme=dark] would also flip its reversed text tokens.

ui-icons.divergesFromFigma: Figma sets UI/Icons to #767676 (Greyscale/6). Tiffany chose Greyscale/5 instead, so icons match the secondary text colour and read a little stronger.

ui-background-tertiary-background.note: The quiet surface filter chips, map controls and read-only fields sit on.
